purpose: Budgeted word-feature screening followed by a fixed char_wb ablation and paired split-sensitivity check; no test-set inspection before the final locked fit.
tie_break: highest Macro-F1; exact ties keep the first candidate in the fixed order below

stage1.word_best_rule: Choose the best among the A, B, and C step winners in A-to-C order, after deduplication; exact ties keep the earlier winner.

stage2.normalization: Each TfidfVectorizer branch uses L2 normalization. For fusion, scale each branch by its fixed weight, hstack CSR matrices, then L2-normalize the combined rows. Single-branch matrices skip redundant post-normalization so word_only reproduces the original word matrix exactly.
stage2.best_fusion_rule: Highest seed-42 validation Macro-F1 among the four fusion arms; exact ties keep the fixed arm order.
stage2.seed42_overall_rule: Compare all unique stage-1 candidates, the frozen baseline, and all stage-2 arms in first-appearance order; exact Macro-F1 ties keep the earliest candidate.

stage3.summary: Compute per-seed arm-minus-baseline deltas first, then report their mean and sample standard deviation. No confidence intervals, significance tests, or independence claims; the folds overlap and reuse previously observed labeled rows.

measurements.csr_memory_definition: data.nbytes + indices.nbytes + indptr.nbytes for each CSR matrix; this is sparse feature-matrix storage, not process RSS.
measurements.training_metrics_interpretation: Training scores are resubstitution diagnostics only, not generalization estimates.

constraints: Do not modify run_experiment.py, reproduction_check.py, results/, results_reproduced/, or root predictions.csv.
Do not use test texts or labels to design features, choose settings, or compare candidates.
Do not add model families, dependencies, data cleaning, or unplanned search dimensions.
